# Must match website.title in _quarto.yml: Quarto only skips the
# "{title} – {site}" suffix when the two are identical. The title block
# itself is hidden on this page by CSS; the visible H1 is in the hero.
title: "Jubayer Hossain - Multiomics and Machine Learning"
description-meta: "Multiomics scientist integrating bulk, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics to decode cancer biology from public omics data."
image: files/profiles/jubayer.jpg
page-layout: full
toc: false
title-block-banner: false
anchor-sections: false
listing:
  - id: featured-list
    contents: data/featured.yml
    template: _templates/featured-card.ejs

    contents:
      - data/publications/conference-presentations.yml
      - data/publications/invited-speaker.yml
      - data/publications/posters.yml
    template: _templates/talk-item.ejs
  - id: resources-list
    contents:
      - data/home-resources.yml
      - data/teaching/videos.yml
    template: _templates/home-resource-card.ejs
  - id: preprints-list
    contents: data/publications/preprints.yml
    template: _templates/home-preprint.ejs

    template: _templates/home-publication.ejs

```{=html}
<section class="profile-hero hero page-full">
<div class="hero-body container is-max-widescreen">
<div class="hero-layout">
<div class="hero-copy">
<p class="eyebrow">Multiomics &middot; Cancer Genomics &middot; Machine Learning</p>
<h1 class="title hero-title">Jubayer Hossain</h1>
<p class="hero-subtitle">Multiomics scientist decoding cancer biology from public transcriptomic data.</p>
<div class="hero-description">
<p>I build reproducible computational workflows on public omics data &mdash; meta-analysing bulk RNA-Seq cohorts, constructing harmonised single-cell atlases, and applying machine learning to high-dimensional data for biomarker discovery.</p>
<p>I founded <a href="https://deepbioltd.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">DeepBio Limited</a>, a Dhaka-based AI and bioinformatics company, and <a href="https://chiralbd.github.io" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CHIRAL Bangladesh</a>, a non-profit research institute that has trained 3,000+ early-career researchers. I teach through <a href="https://deepbioacademy.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">DeepBio Academy</a> and mentor students from raw sequencing data to published analysis.</p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  // The navbar section links are resolved by Quarto to "./#talks", and Quarto's
  // own nav script then rewrites them to absolute URLs, so on the homepage a
  // click would reload the page instead of scrolling. Intercept at click time,
  // which is after any of that rewriting has happened.
  document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    var a = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('.navbar a[href]');
    if (!a || !a.hash || ev.metaKey || ev.ctrlKey || ev.shiftKey || ev.button !== 0) return;
    var here = location.pathname.replace(/index\.html$/, '');
    var there = a.pathname.replace(/index\.html$/, '');
    if (there !== here) return;
    var el = document.querySelector(a.hash);
    if (!el) return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    history.replaceState(null, '', a.hash);
  });

  // Talks category filter
  var talkItems = document.querySelectorAll('#talks-timeline .talk-item');
  document.querySelectorAll('#talks .filter-bar .filter-button').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var filter = this.getAttribute('data-filter');
      document.querySelectorAll('#talks .filter-bar .filter-button').forEach(function (b) {
        b.classList.remove('is-active');
      });
      this.classList.add('is-active');
      talkItems.forEach(function (item) {
        if (filter === 'all' || item.getAttribute('data-category') === filter) {
          item.style.display = 'grid';
        } else {
          item.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    });
  });

  // Publications topic filter
  var pubItems = document.querySelectorAll('#publications-list [data-pub-item]');
  document.querySelectorAll('#publications-list .filter-bar .filter-button').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var filter = this.getAttribute('data-pub-filter');
      document.querySelectorAll('#publications-list .filter-bar .filter-button').forEach(function (b) {
        b.classList.remove('is-active');
      });
      this.classList.add('is-active');
      var detailsDrawer = document.querySelector('#publications-list .earlier-publications');
      if (detailsDrawer && filter !== 'all') {
        detailsDrawer.open = true;
      }
      pubItems.forEach(function (item) {
        var tags = (item.getAttribute('data-pub-tags') || '').split(' ');
        if (filter === 'all' || tags.indexOf(filter) !== -1) {
          item.style.display = 'grid';
        } else {
          item.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
